exposure: Use of EDC-associated hair products during pregnancy
Daily use of hair oils during late pregnancy
cohort: The study included 154 pregnant participants enrolled in the Environmental Reproductive and Glucose Outcomes (ERGO) Study between 2018 and 2020 in the Boston, Massachusetts area.
finding: Frequent daily use of hair oils during late pregnancy (around 36 weeks' gestation) was associated with a lower mean gestational age at delivery, specifically 8.3 days shorter, compared to non-users.
gest_age: Gestational age at delivery was measured, with mean gestational ages reported around 38.2-39.2 weeks, and 7% of participants delivering preterm.
